scope: Evidence-backed obligation inventory of the exact 68 definitions. Entire engine remains the goal. No card, deck, timing family or production release is certified by this audit.

verification.method: Inspected exact manifests, card functions, named tests and saved actual GEMP receipts/results; inspected duel guard and v5 replay attrition comparison. No runtime/broad tests, oracle, browser or service execution by this audit.
verification.compound: Compound owner reports promoted starter-compound.test.mjs passes 3/3: two actual GEMP outcome comparisons plus pinned receipt integrity. Inspected two recorded observations and provenance reporting 2/2 successful reference tests, 6820 unchanged production files.
distinctions: A source/test filename is a pointer, not execution or behavior proof.
An inspected native assertion shows what is checked; its execution status belongs to the integrator test receipt.
Controlled board/zone interventions in reference fixtures are not claims of legal card-provider reachability.
Selected complete matches do not exhaust all legal choices.
Absence from exact pair excludes provider branches only for these exact counts; broader requirements remain.

exactPair.primaryFamilyCoverage: Exactly one family per definition; shared rules and cross-family interactions remain explicit obligations.
